rv.q: In Baker’s brilliant The Antipodes (given its UK premiere at the National Theatre), the hunt for plot turns into a quest. Her characters sit around a vast, empty table, trying to dream up an original yarn.
‘The Antipodes’ – which has its UK premiere in a production co-directed by Baker herself and designer Chloe Lamford – is utterly, gloriously out there and will doubtless horrify some people.
